UnitStatement: BOE_STRUCTURE.md defines structural contracts for Basis-of-Estimate artifacts produced by the estimate-prep phases.
Phase SCAFFOLD produces BOE_Scaffold.md under {snapshot}/Scaffold/BOE_Scaffold.md.
BOE_Scaffold.md must include a per-deliverable table with DeliverableID, Name, Package, BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE, FALLBACK_POLICY, ALLOW_MIXED, Substance, Cost Drivers, and Primary Roles.
BOE_Scaffold.md must include package cost ownership hints for scope items mapped to multiple deliverables.
BOE_Scaffold.md must include SOW multi-mapping warnings for double-counting risks.
BOE_Scaffold.md must be marked DRAFT - requires human review.
Phase BOE produces BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md as {snapshot}/BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md.
When a canonical BOE exists for a project, the generated BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md must follow that canonical structure.

Without a canonical BOE, BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md must include Purpose, Project Context, Estimation Scope, Estimation Strategy, Per-Deliverable Estimation Plan, Dependency-Informed Run Sequence, Missing or Weak PRICE_SOURCES Register, Aggregation Strategy, Assumptions and Constraints Log, and Document Control in order.
The Per-Deliverable Plan must include every deliverable from the decomposition.
The Per-Deliverable Plan must record cost ownership rules for every package with multi-deliverable scope overlap.
The Run Sequence must assign every deliverable a tier.
Run Sequence tier assignments must be consistent with dependencies.
Dependency cycles must be detected and reported in QA plus Conflicts.
The PRICE_SOURCES Register must identify and prioritize low-confidence items impacting the plan.
The Assumptions Log must merge scaffold assumptions and BOE derivations with IDs and impact-if-wrong.
Run_Context.md is produced at the root of every snapshot folder.
Run_Context.md must include RunID, AsOf, Phase, Mode, EXECUTION_ROOT, DECOMPOSITION_PATH, SOURCE_DOCUMENTS, PROJECT_CONTEXT, CURRENCY, SCHEMA_MODE, EXPORT_BUNDLE, and Warnings when present.
Run_Context.md records RATE_SCOPE for SCAFFOLD runs and SCAFFOLD_PATH plus DEPENDENCY_SOURCES for BOE runs.
Run_Context.md records HUMAN_PRICING and PRIOR_SNAPSHOT for ENRICH mode and CANONICAL_PRICESOURCES_ROOT when used.
Publish_Manifest.md is produced at {snapshot}/Publish_Manifest.md at the end of every run.
Publish_Manifest.md describes how to publish snapshot outputs to canonical locations, and publication remains human-owned.
Publish_Manifest.md must include the snapshot path, intended canonical destinations, file-by-file copy list, and approval warning.
If Publish_Package exists, Publish_Manifest.md should point to it.
The Publish_Manifest.md manifest is a proposal.
The estimate-prep skill must not copy files into _PriceSources or other canonical locations.
The estimate-prep skill must not create or modify BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md outside the snapshot folder.
The estimate-prep skill must not commit to git or push to any remote.
The estimate-prep skill must not take irreversible publication action.
estimate-prep runs exactly one phase per invocation, selected by the PHASE brief parameter.
The SCAFFOLD phase generates a parametric pricing baseline and BOE scaffold for human review.
The BOE phase consumes approved scaffold and dependency evidence to produce the full BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md.
Any PHASE value other than SCAFFOLD or BOE produces RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS.
A single estimate-prep run must not span both phases.
TaskSkill must be estimate-prep in the common required brief fields.
Common required brief fields include PHASE, EXECUTION_ROOT, DECOMPOSITION_PATH, SOURCE_DOCUMENTS, CURRENCY, and PROJECT_CONTEXT.
PROJECT_CONTEXT requires Location, BaseYear, ProjectType, and ProcurementModel.
PROJECT_CONTEXT may include EstimatedValue and AdditionalContext.
Common optional brief fields include OUTPUT_LABEL, SECONDARY_SOURCES, CANONICAL_PRICESOURCES_ROOT, SCHEMA_MODE, and EXPORT_BUNDLE.
For SCAFFOLD, MODE defaults to BOOTSTRAP and may be BOOTSTRAP or ENRICH.
For SCAFFOLD ENRICH mode, PRIOR_SNAPSHOT is required unless CANONICAL_PRICESOURCES_ROOT is provided instead.
For SCAFFOLD, HUMAN_PRICING may provide human pricing from quotes, rate tables, historical data, vendor proposals, CSV, markdown, PDF, or structured text.
For SCAFFOLD, RATE_SCOPE defaults to PRODUCTION_ONLY and may be PRODUCTION_ONLY or PRODUCTION_AND_CONSTRUCTION.
For SCAFFOLD, DISCIPLINE_HINTS may override or supplement discipline detection from decomposition.
For BOE, SCAFFOLD_PATH is required and points to the approved SCAFFOLD snapshot.
For BOE, DEPENDENCY_SOURCES defaults to AUTO or may specify explicit dependency source paths.
For BOE, EVALUATION_CRITERIA may be a path or structured block of criteria with point allocations.
For BOE, AGGREGATION_HINTS may provide human-specified aggregation preferences.
estimate-prep writes only to {EXECUTION_ROOT}/_EstimatePrep/.
Each estimate-prep run creates a new immutable snapshot folder.
SCAFFOLD snapshot folders use EPREP_SCAFFOLD_{LABEL}_{DATE}_{TIME}/.
BOE snapshot folders use EPREP_BOE_{LABEL}_{DATE}_{TIME}/.
AUTO_FROM_CANONICAL with CANONICAL_PRICESOURCES_ROOT produces output CSV headers matching the canonical library exactly.
MANIFEST_AND_PACKAGE writes Publish_Package inside the write quarantine.
Human publication to canonical locations remains a separate approved step.
All resolved defaults and chosen paths are recorded in Run_Context.md.
PROJECT_CONTEXT can be inlined in the brief or provided as a path to a structured file.
PriceSources/INDEX.md defines the Phase SCAFFOLD contract for {snapshot}/PriceSources/INDEX.md.
The file inventory portion of PriceSources/INDEX.md is generated using tools/reporting/generate_index_md.sh against {snapshot}/PriceSources/.
PriceSources/INDEX.md must augment the inventory with seven required sections.
The PriceSources/INDEX.md header block must include execution root, BOE path, currency, base year, region, prepared date, and status.
The data quality statement must define HIGH, MEDIUM, and LOW confidence levels aligned to estimating accuracy expectations.
HIGH confidence means a confirmed parameter or fixed allowance with exact accuracy.
MEDIUM confidence means a parametric rate or typical effort estimate with +/-20-30% accuracy.
LOW confidence means an allowance or rough parametric value with +/-30-50% accuracy.
The PriceSources/INDEX.md file inventory table uses file name, item count, and primary consumer or used-by columns.
The PS-ID mapping section maps BOE price-source IDs to files and key items.
The ESTIMATING run configuration includes a Deliverable-to-Package mapping table.
The per-package PRICE_SOURCES mapping lists literal file paths ESTIMATING should load for each package.
The per-package PRICE_SOURCES mapping differentiates production-only deliverables from dual-nature deliverables with construction pricing.
The ESTIMATING usage guidance tells ESTIMATING to use RecommendedRate as point estimate, flag low-confidence items, and record Basis in Detail.csv Method.
The open issues table lists issues affecting PRICE_SOURCES with impact and status.
The gaps table lists items needing parametric estimation or future quotes with workaround.
ESTIMATING consumes INDEX.md to locate PRICE_SOURCES file paths per package.
ESTIMATING consumes INDEX.md to apply confidence-based risk flags.
ESTIMATING consumes INDEX.md to record Basis values in Detail.csv rows.
Changes to INDEX.md structure impact ESTIMATING Detail.csv generation.
estimate-prep QA invariants apply to both phases unless explicitly marked SCAFFOLD only or BOE only.
QA check S1 requires no files created or modified outside {EXECUTION_ROOT}/_EstimatePrep/.
QA check S2 requires a new snapshot folder for every run, including failed runs.
QA check S3 requires PHASE to be present and equal SCAFFOLD or BOE.
QA check S3b requires the run not to span both phases and preserves the human gate.
QA_Report.md declares RUN_STATUS as OK, WARNINGS, or FAILED_INPUTS.
Publish_Manifest.md must exist and reference the run outputs.
A SCAFFOLD run requires Run_Context.md, QA_Report.md, Source_Index.md, Confidence_Summary.md, PriceSources/INDEX.md, Scaffold/BOE_Scaffold.md, an appropriate pricing CSV, and Publish_Manifest.md.
A SCAFFOLD ENRICH run requires Override_Log.csv.
A SCAFFOLD run requires Conflicts.csv when conflicts are detected.
A SCAFFOLD run includes Publish_Package only when EXPORT_BUNDLE=MANIFEST_AND_PACKAGE.
A BOE run requires Run_Context.md, QA_Report.md, Source_Index.md, BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md, Tier_Analysis.md, Decision_Log.md, Assumptions_Log.md, and Publish_Manifest.md.
A BOE run requires Conflicts.csv when dependency cycles or contradictions are detected.
A BOE run includes Publish_Package only when EXPORT_BUNDLE=MANIFEST_AND_PACKAGE.
Every generated CSV must match the canonical schema family or discovered canonical file in exact column names and order.
Generated CSVs must not contain empty ItemID, ParameterID, RoleID, TradeID, or DeliverableID key fields.
For files with min, max, and recommended columns, recommended values must fall within min and max unless Notes justify otherwise.
Generated CSVs may not add columns beyond the canonical schema.
Rate and pricing files in Families 1-7 require non-empty Basis and non-empty Confidence.
Project parameter rows in Family 8 require non-empty Source and non-empty Confidence.
Level of effort rows in Family 9 require non-empty Basis and no Confidence column.
Parametric defaults must use Basis=PARAMETRIC with Confidence MEDIUM or LOW, never HIGH.
HIGH confidence values must trace to a vendor quote, human confirmation, or source document, not parametric defaults.
Rate and pricing Basis canonical values are MARKET, PARAMETRIC, ALLOWANCE, and N/A, with ENRICH additions QUOTE, HUMAN_PROVIDED, and HUMAN_CONFIRMED.
Project parameter Source canonical values are ASSUMPTION, DESIGN_BASIS, CONFIRMED, DERIVED, and PARAMETRIC, with ENRICH addition HUMAN_PROVIDED.
Level of effort Basis canonical value is PARAMETRIC, with ENRICH additions MARKET and HUMAN_PROVIDED.
Values outside the canonical enums require explicit justification in Notes or are treated as FAILED_INPUTS.
Override_Log.csv is present in SCAFFOLD ENRICH snapshots.
Every overridden value must be recorded in Override_Log.csv.
Override_Log.csv columns include OverrideID, File, Key, Field, prior values and provenance, new values and provenance, HumanSource, and Notes.
Overrides that change a HIGH-confidence value require human-source documentation.
BOE completeness requires every decomposition deliverable to appear in the per-deliverable estimation plan.
BOE completeness requires cost ownership rules for every package with multi-deliverable scope overlap.
BOE completeness requires a canonical run sequence with tiers, within-tier parallelism, chains, and gates.
BOE completeness requires rollups from deliverables to packages to project totals.
BOE completeness requires all 10 BOE sections when no canonical BOE format exists.
BOE tier sequencing requires every deliverable to be assigned a tier.
BOE tier assignments must be consistent with the dependency DAG.
Dependency cycles must be reported in QA_Report.md and Conflicts.csv.
Dependency registers are read-only inputs and must not be modified.
Conflicts must be surfaced in Conflicts.csv rather than silently resolved.
Conflict triggers include disagreeing human sources, canonical schema discovery failures, contradictory required inputs, and BOE dependency cycles.
Conflicts.csv columns are ConflictID, Key, Description, Contenders, ProposedAuthority, HumanRuling, and Notes.
HumanRuling remains TBD in every generated Conflicts.csv row.
estimate-prep must not unilaterally accept or issue the BOE strategy or publish canonical outputs.
estimate-prep must not resolve conflicts between disagreeing sources.
estimate-prep must not approve overrides that would change a HIGH-confidence value.
estimate-prep must not make scope boundary decisions for in/out, base, option, or alternate status.
estimate-prep must not execute irreversible publication actions such as git commit, git push, or copy into _PriceSources.
Human-owned decisions surfaced during a run are recorded as proposals with HumanRuling=TBD.
FAILED_INPUTS applies when PHASE is missing or invalid, required inputs are missing or malformed, or a run spans both phases.
WARNINGS applies when a run completes with surfaced conflicts, low-confidence attention items, partial coverage, or schema discovery warnings.
OK applies when a run completes with no warnings, no conflicts, and all required artifacts present.
QA_Report.md must declare exactly one RUN_STATUS value.
A clean SCAFFOLD status reports RUN_STATUS=OK, snapshot path, pricing file counts and rows, confidence distribution, BOE scaffold path, Publish_Manifest presence, and conflict or override status.

A clean BOE status reports RUN_STATUS=OK, snapshot path, deliverable count, tier distribution, cycle detection result, BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md path, Publish_Manifest presence, and scaffold modification logging.
Run_Context.md records all resolved defaults, chosen paths, phase, and mode.
Decision_Log.md records defaults applied, methods used, and human modifications.
Assumptions_Log.md records explicit assumptions with IDs and impact-if-wrong.
Source_Index.md records the source document index.
Confidence_Summary.md records per-file confidence distribution for SCAFFOLD runs.
Override_Log.csv records every ENRICH override with before and after values.
Conflicts.csv records unresolved conflicts with proposed authority and human ruling TBD.
The Schema Annex covers nine schema families for all 18 canonical CSV files in the _PriceSources library.
The Schema Annex was hardened against the canonical _PriceSources library as of 2026-02-18.
Family 1 standard unit-rate files use header ItemID, Category, Description, Unit, RateMin, RateMax, RecommendedRate, Basis, Confidence, Notes.

Family 1 covers Structural_Concrete_Rates, Building_Envelope_Rates, Mechanical_System_Rates, Electrical_System_Rates, Earthwork_Civil_Rates, Paving_Surfacing_Rates, Underground_Utility_Rates, Fees_Permits_Insurance, and Interior_Architectural_Rates.
Family 1 observed Basis values are MARKET, PARAMETRIC, ALLOWANCE, and N/A.
Family 1 observed Confidence values are HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, and N/A.
Family 1 ESTIMATING guidance uses RecommendedRate as point estimate, records RateMin and RateMax for risk analysis, and flags Confidence=LOW items for vendor quote replacement.
Family 2 Equipment_Pricing.csv uses header ItemID, Category, Description, Unit, PriceMin, PriceMax, RecommendedPrice, Quantity_Assumed, Basis, Confidence, Notes.
Family 2 uses Price columns rather than Rate columns.
Family 2 Quantity_Assumed is present and may be blank for lump-sum items.
Family 3 Optional_Items_Pricing.csv uses header ItemID, Category, Description, Unit, PriceMin, PriceMax, RecommendedPrice, Basis, Confidence, Notes.
Family 3 uses Price columns rather than Rate columns and has no Quantity_Assumed column.
Family 3 options include base scope, alternates, and items pending resolution.
Family 4 Professional_Staff_Rates.csv uses header RoleID, Role, Category, HourlyRate_CAD, Basis, Confidence, Notes.
Family 4 has a single rate per role with no min, max, or recommended pattern.
Family 4 uses Role rather than RoleName.
Family 4 Category groups roles such as Design, Management, Construction, Admin, and Specialty.
Family 4 embeds currency in HourlyRate_CAD.
Family 5 Construction_Labour_Rates.csv uses header TradeID, Trade, HourlyRate_CAD, BurdenMultiplier, FullyBurdenedRate_CAD, Basis, Confidence, Notes.
Family 5 uses a single rate with burden multiplier to produce fully burdened rate.
Family 5 has no min or max pattern and uses TradeID rather than ItemID.
Family 6 Professional_Design_Fees.csv uses header ItemID, Discipline, Description, FeePercentMin, FeePercentMax, RecommendedPercent, FeeBase, Basis, Confidence, Notes.
Family 6 uses Discipline rather than Category.
Family 6 fee percent columns use the min, max, and recommended pattern.
Family 6 FeeBase indicates the percentage basis, such as construction_value.
Family 6 items DF-06, DF-07, and DF-08 use lump_sum in percent fields when the fee is fixed rather than percentage-based.
Family 7 Parametric_Building_Rates.csv uses header ItemID, BuildingType, Description, Unit, RateMin, RateMax, RecommendedRate, Basis, Confidence, Notes.
Family 7 uses BuildingType rather than Category.
Family 7 otherwise follows the standard unit-rate column pattern.
Family 7 is used for parametric cross-checks and fallback estimation.
Family 8 Assumed_Project_Parameters.csv uses header ParameterID, Category, Parameter, Value, Unit, Source, Confidence, Notes.
Family 8 uses Source rather than Basis.
Family 8 has no rate columns and each parameter is a single Value.
Family 8 observed Source values are ASSUMPTION, DESIGN_BASIS, CONFIRMED, DERIVED, and PARAMETRIC.
Family 8 observed Confidence values are HIGH, MEDIUM, and LOW.
Family 9 Level of Effort files use header Execution, DeliverableID, DeliverableName, RoleID, Role, EstimatedHours, Basis, Notes.
Family 9 covers Proposal_Level_of_Effort.csv for multi-execution shared use and Level_of_Effort.csv for execution-specific use.
Family 9 has no Confidence column because provenance is conveyed through Basis alone.
Family 9 requires all columns, including Execution, DeliverableName, and Role.
Family 9 observed Basis value is PARAMETRIC.
HIGH confidence means human-confirmed, vendor-quoted, or source-document-derived.
MEDIUM confidence means a parametric market rate or comparable-project benchmark.
LOW confidence means an allowance or assumption-based placeholder.
Override_Log.csv minimum columns are OverrideID, File, Key, Field, PriorValue, PriorConfidence, PriorBasis or PriorSource, NewValue, NewConfidence, NewBasis or NewSource, HumanSource, and Notes.
Conflicts.csv schema includes ConflictID, Key, Description, Contenders, ProposedAuthority, HumanRuling, and Notes.
estimate-prep generates the complete input package consumed by ESTIMATING agents.
The estimate-prep input package includes pricing libraries, effort matrices, project parameter assumptions, and the Basis of Estimate.
estimate-prep SCAFFOLD generates a parametric pricing baseline and BOE scaffold for human review.
estimate-prep BOE consumes the approved scaffold and dependency evidence to produce BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md with tier sequencing, cost ownership rules, and aggregation strategy.
Each estimate-prep invocation runs exactly one phase selected by PHASE.
The human gate between SCAFFOLD and BOE is external to the skill.
estimate-prep must not compute or publish project totals, bid prices, or line-item estimates.
estimate-prep prepares inputs consumed by ESTIMATING.
estimate-prep is suitable for the TASK agent shell in generic mode with no profile.
In PHASE=SCAFFOLD, expected inputs are decomposition, source documents, project context, and optional HUMAN_PRICING when MODE=ENRICH.
In PHASE=SCAFFOLD, primary outputs are pricing library CSVs, PriceSources/INDEX.md, and Scaffold/BOE_Scaffold.md.
In PHASE=BOE, expected inputs are approved SCAFFOLD_PATH and dependency evidence.
In PHASE=BOE, primary outputs are BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md and Tier_Analysis.md.
If a brief requests both SCAFFOLD and BOE in one run, estimate-prep halts with FAILED_INPUTS.
Required common inputs are EXECUTION_ROOT, PHASE, DECOMPOSITION_PATH, SOURCE_DOCUMENTS, CURRENCY, and PROJECT_CONTEXT.
PROJECT_CONTEXT includes required Location, BaseYear, ProjectType, and ProcurementModel, with optional EstimatedValue and AdditionalContext.
Optional common inputs are OUTPUT_LABEL, SECONDARY_SOURCES, CANONICAL_PRICESOURCES_ROOT, SCHEMA_MODE, and EXPORT_BUNDLE.
SCAFFOLD-specific inputs include MODE, PRIOR_SNAPSHOT, HUMAN_PRICING, RATE_SCOPE, and DISCIPLINE_HINTS.
BOE-specific input SCAFFOLD_PATH is required.
BOE-specific optional inputs include DEPENDENCY_SOURCES, EVALUATION_CRITERIA, and AGGREGATION_HINTS.
All resolved defaults and chosen paths must be recorded in Run_Context.md.
Runtime override PHASE is required and may be SCAFFOLD or BOE.
Runtime override MODE applies to SCAFFOLD and defaults to BOOTSTRAP.
Runtime override RATE_SCOPE applies to SCAFFOLD and defaults to PRODUCTION_ONLY.
Runtime override SCHEMA_MODE defaults to AUTO_FROM_CANONICAL.
Runtime override EXPORT_BUNDLE defaults to MANIFEST_ONLY.
Runtime override DEPENDENCY_SOURCES applies to BOE and defaults to AUTO.
Runtime override OUTPUT_LABEL defaults to AUTO.
estimate-prep omits an allowed-tools frontmatter allowlist.
estimate-prep preferred utility scripts validate PHASE, create _EstimatePrep, create the immutable snapshot folder, and generate the INDEX.md file inventory.
Reasoning and file-write operations generate estimate-prep content based on canonical schemas in the Schema Annex.
estimate-prep must not write outside {EXECUTION_ROOT}/_EstimatePrep/.
estimate-prep must not overwrite prior snapshots.
estimate-prep must not modify _PriceSources, _Estimates, deliverable folders, decomposition outputs, or dependency registers.
estimate-prep must not recursively ingest prior _EstimatePrep outputs unless explicitly provided as PRIOR_SNAPSHOT or SCAFFOLD_PATH.
SCAFFOLD step 1 validates PHASE, bootstraps _EstimatePrep, and creates the EPREP_SCAFFOLD snapshot folder.
SCAFFOLD step 2 loads decomposition to extract Package IDs, Deliverable IDs, scope items, disciplines, owner roles, and variant hints.
SCAFFOLD step 3 loads source documents to extract project metadata, timeline, submission requirements, scope boundaries, standards, and constraints.
SCAFFOLD step 3 records TBD for source-document items not found.
SCAFFOLD step 4 uses exact canonical headers when AUTO_FROM_CANONICAL finds a matching canonical file; otherwise it uses the Schema Annex.
SCAFFOLD step 5 generates Professional_Staff_Rates.csv with default Confidence=MEDIUM and Basis=PARAMETRIC.
SCAFFOLD ENRICH overlays human rates and logs each Professional_Staff_Rates.csv override.
SCAFFOLD step 6 generates Level_of_Effort.csv with default Basis=PARAMETRIC and no Confidence column.
SCAFFOLD step 7 generates Assumed_Project_Parameters.csv using Source rather than Basis.
SCAFFOLD step 8 generates applicable Family 1-7 rate tables when RATE_SCOPE=PRODUCTION_AND_CONSTRUCTION.
SCAFFOLD step 9 generates PriceSources/INDEX.md with the required seven sections.
SCAFFOLD step 10 generates BOE_Scaffold.md with per-deliverable table, package cost ownership hints, SOW multi-mapping warnings, and draft marking.
SCAFFOLD step 11 produces Confidence_Summary.md, QA_Report.md, Decision_Log.md, Assumptions_Log.md, Source_Index.md, conditional Override_Log.csv, conditional Conflicts.csv, and Publish_Manifest.md.
BOE step 1 creates the EPREP_BOE snapshot folder.
BOE step 2 reads SCAFFOLD_PATH and logs human modifications in Decision_Log.md.
BOE step 3 reads dependency sources, builds the dependency DAG, and detects cycles.
BOE step 4 assigns tiers via topological layering and identifies sequential chains and parallelization opportunities.
BOE step 4 outputs Tier_Analysis.md.

BOE step 5 generates a per-deliverable estimation plan from tier assignments, scaffold basis, fallback policy, mixed-method status, substance, cost drivers, required price sources, and package cost ownership rules.
BOE step 6 generates dependency-informed run sequence with tiers, within-tier parallelism, sequential chains, and gates.
BOE step 7 generates aggregation strategy from deliverables to packages to project totals and adds evaluation-weight views when EVALUATION_CRITERIA is provided.
BOE step 8 generates a missing or weak PRICE_SOURCES register that prioritizes low-confidence items impacting the plan.
BOE step 9 compiles assumptions and constraints by merging scaffold assumptions and BOE derivations with IDs and impact-if-wrong.
BOE step 10 compiles full BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md using a canonical BOE structure if available, otherwise the 10-section BOE set.
BOE step 11 produces QA_Report.md, Decision_Log.md, Assumptions_Log.md, Source_Index.md, conditional Conflicts.csv, and Publish_Manifest.md.

The SCAFFOLD snapshot includes Run_Context.md, PriceSources outputs, Scaffold outputs, Confidence_Summary.md, QA_Report.md, Decision_Log.md, Assumptions_Log.md, Source_Index.md, optional Override_Log.csv, optional Conflicts.csv, Publish_Manifest.md, and optional Publish_Package.

The BOE snapshot includes Run_Context.md, BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md, Tier_Analysis.md, QA_Report.md, Decision_Log.md, Assumptions_Log.md, Source_Index.md, optional Conflicts.csv, Publish_Manifest.md, and optional Publish_Package.
Publishing to canonical locations is separate and human-approved.
Snapshots are immutable.
SCAFFOLD and BOE are distinct invocations separated by a human gate.
Generated values must carry provenance appropriate to their schema family.
Families 1-7 carry Basis plus Confidence provenance.
Family 8 carries Source plus Confidence provenance.
Family 9 carries Basis alone and no Confidence.
Parametric values must use PARAMETRIC with MEDIUM or LOW confidence and never HIGH.
Only human-confirmed, vendor-quoted, or directly source-document-derived values earn HIGH confidence.
ENRICH mode must log every human-data overlay in Override_Log.csv.
If sources disagree or schema mismatches exist, estimate-prep produces Conflicts.csv instead of silently choosing a winner.
Dependency registers inform BOE tier sequencing but are never modified.
Every generated CSV must match exact Schema Annex or discovered canonical column names and order.
Human decision rights include accepting or issuing BOE strategy and publishing canonical outputs.
Human decision rights include rulings on conflicts, scope overlaps, and contradictory dependency assertions.
Human decision rights include approving any override that would change a HIGH-confidence value.
Human decision rights include scope boundary decisions for in/out, base, option, or alternate status.
Human decision rights include any irreversible publication action.
Human rulings should be recorded in scaffold or BOE artifacts or a separate decision log.
estimate-prep QA expects a QA_Report.md RUN_STATUS of OK, WARNINGS, or FAILED_INPUTS.
estimate-prep QA expects a snapshot folder for every run, including failures.
estimate-prep QA expects no writes outside _EstimatePrep.
estimate-prep QA expects CSV schemas to match the canonical Schema Annex exactly.
estimate-prep QA expects complete provenance per schema family.
estimate-prep QA expects Publish_Manifest.md to exist and reference run outputs.
estimate-prep QA expects phase-specific required artifacts to be present.
SCHEMA_ANNEX.md covers nine canonical CSV schema families and enum references for Basis, Source, Confidence, Override_Log.csv, and Conflicts.csv.
BOE_STRUCTURE.md defines BOE_Scaffold.md, the 10-section BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE.md fallback, Run_Context.md fields, and Publish_Manifest.md handoff contract.
INDEX_MD_CONTRACT.md defines the seven-section PriceSources/INDEX.md contract and ESTIMATING run configuration block.
estimate-prep tool policy prefers validate_enum.py before scaffold_tool_root.sh, create_snapshot_folder.sh, generate_index_md.sh, and reasoning plus file writes.
No TASK-enforced deterministic tools are listed because allowed-tools frontmatter is intentionally omitted.
Operational helper tools are validate_enum.py, scaffold_tool_root.sh, create_snapshot_folder.sh, and generate_index_md.sh.
All content after deterministic setup is produced by reasoning and file-write operations.
Tool policy disallows hidden reliance on tools outside the declared list unless the human expands AllowedTools.
Tool policy disallows writes outside the declared scope.
Tool policy write boundary is only under {EXECUTION_ROOT}/_EstimatePrep/ into a new per-run snapshot folder.
